spec.description: n8n, Hermes Agent, Hermes Kanban 및 OpenViking 통합 모니터링 대시보드.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('$__interval', ended_at) AS time,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed') AS completed,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') AS failed
FROM observability.hermes_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at)
  AND status IN ('completed', 'failed')
  AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
  AND model ~ '${model:regex}'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
  tools.key AS tool,
  sum(tools.value::bigint) AS calls
FROM observability.hermes_runs AS runs
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(runs.tool_usage) AS tools
WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(runs.ended_at, runs.started_at))
  AND runs.profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
  AND runs.model ~ '${model:regex}'
GROUP BY tools.key
ORDER BY calls DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT
  ended_at AS "시각",
  profile AS "프로필",
  model AS "모델",
  source AS "소스",
  end_reason AS "종료 사유",
  round((duration_ms / 1000.0)::numeric, 1) AS "처리시간(초)"
FROM observability.hermes_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(ended_at, started_at))
  AND status = 'failed'
  AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
  AND model ~ '${model:regex}'
ORDER BY COALESCE(ended_at, started_at) DESC
LIMIT 20;

WITH profile_model_usage AS (
  SELECT
    profile,
    model,
    count(*) AS run_count,
    COALESCE(sum(
      input_tokens + output_tokens + reasoning_tokens
      + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens
    ), 0) AS total_tokens,
    round(avg(
      input_tokens + output_tokens + reasoning_tokens
      + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens
    )::numeric, 0) AS avg_tokens_per_run,
    round(COALESCE(
      sum(duration_ms) FILTER (
        WHERE status IN ('completed', 'failed')
          AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL
      ) / 1000.0,
      0
    )::numeric, 1) AS general_seconds,
    round(COALESCE(
      percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms)
        FILTER (
          WHERE status IN ('completed', 'failed')
            AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL
        ) / 1000.0,
      0
    )::numeric, 1) AS p95_seconds
  FROM observability.hermes_runs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
    AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
    AND model ~ '${model:regex}'
  GROUP BY profile, model
),
kanban_usage AS (
  SELECT
    profile,
    round(COALESCE(
      sum(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ended_at - started_at)),
      0
    )::numeric, 1) AS kanban_seconds
  FROM observability.hermes_kanban_task_runs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
    AND ended_at IS NOT NULL
    AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
  GROUP BY profile
)
SELECT
  p.profile AS "프로필",
  p.model AS "모델",
  p.run_count AS "실행 수",
  p.total_tokens AS "총 토큰",
  p.avg_tokens_per_run AS "실행당 평균 토큰",
  p.general_seconds AS "일반 작업(초)",
  COALESCE(k.kanban_seconds, 0) AS "칸반 작업(초)",
  round((p.general_seconds + COALESCE(k.kanban_seconds, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "전체 작업(초)"
FROM profile_model_usage p
LEFT JOIN kanban_usage k ON k.profile = p.profile
ORDER BY p.profile, "총 토큰" DESC;

WITH general_usage AS (
  SELECT
    profile,
    COALESCE(sum(input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens,
    COALESCE(sum(cache_read_tokens), 0) AS cache_read_tokens,
    COALESCE(sum(output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens,
    COALESCE(sum(reasoning_tokens), 0) AS reasoning_tokens,
    COALESCE(sum(
      input_tokens + output_tokens + reasoning_tokens
      + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens
    ), 0) AS total_tokens,
    round(COALESCE(
      100.0 * sum(cache_read_tokens)
      / NULLIF(sum(input_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens), 0),
      0
    ), 1) AS cache_hit_rate,
    round(COALESCE(
      sum(duration_ms) FILTER (
        WHERE status IN ('completed', 'failed')
          AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL
      ) / 1000.0,
      0
    )::numeric, 1) AS general_seconds
  FROM observability.hermes_runs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
    AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
    AND model ~ '${model:regex}'
  GROUP BY profile
),
kanban_usage AS (
  SELECT
    profile,
    round(COALESCE(
      sum(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ended_at - started_at)),
      0
    )::numeric, 1) AS kanban_seconds
  FROM observability.hermes_kanban_task_runs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
    AND ended_at IS NOT NULL
    AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
  GROUP BY profile
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(g.profile, k.profile) AS "프로필",
  COALESCE(g.input_tokens, 0) AS "일반 입력 토큰",
  COALESCE(g.cache_read_tokens, 0) AS "캐시 읽기 토큰",
  COALESCE(g.output_tokens, 0) AS "출력 토큰",
  COALESCE(g.reasoning_tokens, 0) AS "리즈닝 토큰",
  COALESCE(g.total_tokens, 0) AS "총 토큰",
  COALESCE(g.cache_hit_rate, 0) AS "캐시 적중률",
  COALESCE(g.general_seconds, 0) AS "일반 작업(초)",
  COALESCE(k.kanban_seconds, 0) AS "칸반 작업(초)",
  round((
    COALESCE(g.general_seconds, 0)
    + COALESCE(k.kanban_seconds, 0)
  )::numeric, 1) AS "전체 작업(초)"
FROM general_usage g
FULL OUTER JOIN kanban_usage k ON k.profile = g.profile
ORDER BY "전체 작업(초)" DESC, "총 토큰" DESC;

SELECT count(*) AS value
FROM observability.hermes_kanban_tasks
WHERE board ~ '${board:regex}'
  AND status ~ '${status:regex}'
  AND assignee ~ '${assignee:regex}';

SELECT count(*) AS value
FROM observability.hermes_kanban_tasks
WHERE board ~ '${board:regex}'
  AND status IN ('running', 'blocked', 'triage')
  AND assignee ~ '${assignee:regex}';

SELECT count(*) AS value
FROM observability.hermes_kanban_tasks
WHERE board ~ '${board:regex}'
  AND status = 'running'
  AND assignee ~ '${assignee:regex}'
  AND (last_heartbeat_at IS NULL OR last_heartbeat_at < now() - interval '10 minutes');

SELECT
  CASE status
    WHEN 'done' THEN '완료'
    WHEN 'archived' THEN '보관'
    WHEN 'blocked' THEN '차단'
    WHEN 'running' THEN '실행 중'
    WHEN 'triage' THEN '검토'
    ELSE status
  END AS metric,
  count(*) AS value
FROM observability.hermes_kanban_tasks
WHERE board ~ '${board:regex}'
  AND status ~ '${status:regex}'
  AND assignee ~ '${assignee:regex}'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY value DESC;

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval),
  board AS metric,
  count(*) AS value
FROM observability.hermes_kanban_tasks
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
  AND board ~ '${board:regex}'
  AND status ~ '${status:regex}'
  AND assignee ~ '${assignee:regex}'
GROUP BY 1, board
ORDER BY 1, board;

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(event_time, $__interval),
  CASE run_result
    WHEN 'completed' THEN '완료'
    WHEN 'done' THEN '완료'
    WHEN 'blocked' THEN '차단'
    WHEN 'crashed' THEN '실패'
    WHEN 'reclaimed' THEN '회수'
    WHEN 'timed_out' THEN '시간 초과'
    WHEN 'running' THEN '실행 중'
    WHEN 'unknown' THEN '알 수 없음'
    ELSE run_result
  END AS metric,
  count(*) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(ended_at, started_at) AS event_time,
    board,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(outcome, ''), NULLIF(status, ''), 'unknown') AS run_result
  FROM observability.hermes_kanban_task_runs
) AS runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)
  AND board ~ '${board:regex}'
GROUP BY 1, run_result
ORDER BY 1, run_result;

SELECT
  COALESCE(last_heartbeat_at, started_at, created_at) AS "시각",
  board AS "보드",
  task_id AS "작업 ID",
  title AS "제목",
  assignee AS "담당자",
  CASE status
    WHEN 'running' THEN '실행 중'
    WHEN 'blocked' THEN '차단'
    WHEN 'triage' THEN '검토'
    ELSE status
  END AS "상태",
  latest_run_status AS "최근 실행 상태",
  latest_run_outcome AS "최근 실행 결과",
  consecutive_failures AS "연속 실패 수",
  block_kind AS "차단 유형",
  run_count AS "실행 수",
  result_present AS "결과 존재"
FROM observability.hermes_kanban_tasks
WHERE board ~ '${board:regex}'
  AND assignee ~ '${assignee:regex}'
  AND status IN ('running', 'blocked', 'triage')
ORDER BY COALESCE(last_heartbeat_at, started_at, created_at) DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
  board AS "보드",
  task_id AS "작업 ID",
  title AS "제목",
  assignee AS "담당자",
  CASE status
    WHEN 'done' THEN '완료'
    WHEN 'archived' THEN '보관'
    WHEN 'blocked' THEN '차단'
    WHEN 'running' THEN '실행 중'
    WHEN 'triage' THEN '검토'
    ELSE status
  END AS "상태",
  parent_count AS "상위 작업 수",
  child_count AS "하위 작업 수",
  run_count AS "실행 수",
  comment_count AS "댓글 수",
  attachment_count AS "첨부 수"
FROM observability.hermes_kanban_tasks
WHERE board ~ '${board:regex}'
  AND assignee ~ '${assignee:regex}'
  AND (parent_count > 0 OR child_count > 0)
ORDER BY child_count DESC, parent_count DESC, created_at DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
  COALESCE(last_heartbeat_at, started_at, created_at) AS "시각",
  board AS "보드",
  task_id AS "작업 ID",
  title AS "제목",
  title_hash AS "제목 해시",
  assignee AS "담당자",
  '실행 중' AS "상태",
  latest_run_status AS "최근 실행 상태",
  last_heartbeat_at AS "마지막 신호 시각",
  max_runtime_seconds AS "최대 실행 시간(초)",
  consecutive_failures AS "연속 실패 수"
FROM observability.hermes_kanban_tasks
WHERE board ~ '${board:regex}'
  AND assignee ~ '${assignee:regex}'
  AND status = 'running'
  AND (last_heartbeat_at IS NULL OR last_heartbeat_at < now() - interval '10 minutes')
ORDER BY COALESCE(last_heartbeat_at, started_at, created_at) ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "stoppedAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour') AS "last_1h", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "stoppedAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') AS "last_24h" FROM execution_entity WHERE "stoppedAt" IS NOT NULL

SELECT count(*) AS value
FROM observability.hermes_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
  AND model ~ '${model:regex}';
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS success_rate FROM execution_entity WHERE "stoppedAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS running FROM execution_entity WHERE status = 'running'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS failures FROM execution_entity WHERE status IN ('error','failed') AND "stoppedAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT date_trunc('hour', "stoppedAt") AS time, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') AS success, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('error','failed')) AS failure, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'running') AS running FROM execution_entity WHERE "stoppedAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('hour', "stoppedAt") AS time, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "stoppedAt" - "startedAt")) AS p50_seconds, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "stoppedAt" - "startedAt")) AS p95_seconds FROM execution_entity WHERE "startedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "stoppedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "stoppedAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS executions FROM execution_entity WHERE "stoppedAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY status ORDER BY executions DESC

SELECT COALESCE(w.name, e."workflowId") AS workflow, COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 'success') AS success, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 'success') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS success_rate FROM execution_entity e LEFT JOIN workflow_entity w ON w.id = e."workflowId" WHERE e."stoppedAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY w.name, e."workflowId" ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT "stoppedAt" AS time, COALESCE(w.name, e."workflowId") AS workflow, e.status, e.id AS execution_id FROM execution_entity e LEFT JOIN workflow_entity w ON w.id = e."workflowId" WHERE e.status IN ('error','failed') AND e."stoppedAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' ORDER BY e."stoppedAt" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

options.content:
### 데이터 수집 지표

워크플로우 이름/ID 매핑과 item 수 telemetry가 아직 확정되지 않아 이 영역은 비워 둡니다.

> `workflow_entity` 매핑 후 별도 패널로 추가하세요. 추정값이나 mock 데이터는 표시하지 않습니다.

### 외부 API 오류

현재 `execution_entity`만으로는 HTTP status·retry를 신뢰성 있게 구분할 수 없습니다.

> `execution_data` 또는 별도 telemetry(event_type, status_code, retry_count)가 연결되면 이 영역을 쿼리 패널로 교체하세요.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  profile AS "프로필",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed') AS "완료",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'open') AS "미종료",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') AS "실패",
  round(COALESCE(
    100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed')
    / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed', 'failed')), 0),
    0
  )::numeric, 1) AS "실패율"
FROM observability.hermes_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
  AND model ~ '${model:regex}'
GROUP BY profile
ORDER BY "실패율" DESC, "실패" DESC, profile;

SELECT
  profile AS "프로필",
  board AS "보드",
  count(*) AS "칸반 실행 수",
  round(sum(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ended_at - started_at))::numeric, 1) AS "총 작업시간(초)",
  round(avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ended_at - started_at))::numeric, 1) AS "평균 작업시간(초)",
  round((
    percentile_cont(0.95)
    WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ended_at - started_at))
  )::numeric, 1) AS "p95 작업시간(초)"
FROM observability.hermes_kanban_task_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND ended_at IS NOT NULL
  AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
  AND board ~ '${board:regex}'
GROUP BY profile, board
ORDER BY "총 작업시간(초)" DESC;

SELECT
  percentile_cont(0.95)
    WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS value
FROM observability.hermes_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at)
  AND status IN ('completed', 'failed')
  AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
  AND model ~ '${model:regex}';

SELECT
  COALESCE(
    round(
      (100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed')
       / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed', 'failed')), 0))::numeric,
      1
    ),
    0
  ) AS value
FROM observability.hermes_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
  AND model ~ '${model:regex}';

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(started_at, $__interval),
  profile AS metric,
  sum(input_tokens + output_tokens + reasoning_tokens)::double precision AS value
FROM observability.hermes_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
  AND model ~ '${model:regex}'
GROUP BY 1, profile
ORDER BY 1, profile;

WITH model_usage AS (
  SELECT
    model,
    count(*) AS run_count,
    COALESCE(sum(
      input_tokens + output_tokens + reasoning_tokens
      + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens
    ), 0) AS total_tokens,
    round(avg(
      input_tokens + output_tokens + reasoning_tokens
      + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens
    )::numeric, 0) AS avg_tokens_per_run,
    round(COALESCE(
      sum(duration_ms) FILTER (
        WHERE status IN ('completed', 'failed')
          AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL
      ) / 1000.0,
      0
    )::numeric, 1) AS general_seconds,
    round(COALESCE(
      percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms)
        FILTER (
          WHERE status IN ('completed', 'failed')
            AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL
        ) / 1000.0,
      0
    )::numeric, 1) AS p95_seconds
  FROM observability.hermes_runs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
    AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
    AND model ~ '${model:regex}'
  GROUP BY model
),
kanban_usage AS (
  SELECT
    round(COALESCE(
      sum(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ended_at - started_at)),
      0
    )::numeric, 1) AS kanban_seconds
  FROM observability.hermes_kanban_task_runs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
    AND ended_at IS NOT NULL
    AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
)
SELECT
  m.model AS "모델",
  m.run_count AS "실행 수",
  m.total_tokens AS "총 토큰",
  m.avg_tokens_per_run AS "실행당 평균 토큰",
  m.general_seconds AS "일반 작업(초)",
  k.kanban_seconds AS "칸반 작업(초)",
  round((m.general_seconds + k.kanban_seconds)::numeric, 1) AS "전체 작업(초)"
FROM model_usage m
CROSS JOIN kanban_usage k
ORDER BY "총 토큰" DESC;

SELECT
  status AS metric,
  count(*) AS value
FROM observability.hermes_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
  AND profile ~ '${profile:regex}'
  AND model ~ '${model:regex}'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status;

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  agent AS "에이전트",
  project_label AS "프로젝트",
  model AS "모델",
  sum(request_count) AS "모델 호출 수",
  sum(input_tokens) AS "입력 토큰",
  sum(cache_read_tokens) AS "캐시 읽기",
  sum(cache_write_tokens) AS "캐시 쓰기",
  sum(output_tokens) AS "출력 토큰",
  sum(reasoning_tokens) AS "리즈닝 토큰",
  sum(total_tokens) AS "총 토큰"
FROM observability.orca_usage_daily
WHERE $__timeFilter(usage_date::timestamptz)
GROUP BY agent, project_label, model
ORDER BY "총 토큰" DESC;

SELECT
  agent AS "에이전트",
  project_label AS "프로젝트",
  thread_id AS "쓰레드 ID",
  model AS "모델",
  sum(request_count) AS "모델 호출 수",

ORDER BY "총 토큰" DESC;
